overweight-calculator.formula:
BMI = weight(kg) / height(m) squared
Healthy ceiling = 24.9 x height(m) squared
Excess = weight - healthy ceiling (if above)

Example: 170 cm, 85 kg
BMI = 85 / (1.70 x 1.70) = 85 / 2.89 = 29.4
Ceiling = 24.9 x 2.89 = 72.0 kg
Excess = 85 - 72.0 = 13.0 kg

keyFacts: Overweight = BMI 25-29.9. Obesity starts at 30: class I (30-34.9), class II (35-39.9), class III (40+).
Health risks climb with each class: blood pressure, diabetes, and joint load all rise.
Even a 5-10% weight loss measurably improves blood pressure and blood sugar.
Waist matters too: above 102 cm (men) or 88 cm (women) adds risk at any BMI.
Muscle can push BMI up unfairly - athletes should check body fat instead.
Children use percentile charts, not these adult cut-offs.

overweight-calculator.workedExample:
Height 170 cm, weight 85 kg:
1. Height squared: 1.70 x 1.70 = 2.89.
2. BMI: 85 / 2.89 = 29.4 - Overweight (25-29.9).
3. Healthy ceiling: 24.9 x 2.89 = 72.0 kg.
4. Excess: 85 - 72.0 = 13.0 kg to reach the healthy range.
5. At 0.5 kg per week: 13 / 0.5 = 26 weeks, about 6 months.
